name: Host-Control Binding Conditional Information Test v2
engineering_change_only: preserve upstream input dtype in auxiliary fitting to match the prior float32 hidden-only StandardScaler path; replay tolerance, features, projection, parameters, controls and gates unchanged
changes: fixed auxiliary source readouts only; inherited control proofs and Host contexts; original classifiers, route and thresholds unchanged
feature_definition: inherit the observable per-Role covariance of four proof flags with 74 frozen Host coordinates; apply one fixed label-free signed CountSketch from 9176 to 64 coordinates
projection_definition: SHA256(seed:flat_coordinate) determines bucket via first 8 bytes mod 64 and sign via bit 0 of byte 8; sum signed entries per bucket; no PCA, learned projection, clipping or width search
training: all 639/640 outer-train APKs; same frozen upstream C43 model generates each fold's train and test coordinates; final predictions change only on that fold's frozen routed test APKs
model_selection: NONE. Auxiliary parameters and projection frozen before this test. Training hidden states are upstream in-sample, NOT inner OOF; no inner tuning or claim of a new fully nested upstream fit.
B1_input: frozen hidden + previous coverage64 + previous proof ratios124; must reproduce parent M2_HIDDEN_CONTROL
B3_input: B1 input + within-APK shuffled-binding sketch64; exactly inherited Role/event-count/UNKNOWN-count strata and distinct-Host rotation; all prior marginals unchanged
B4_input: B1 input + 64 random coordinates with mean/std fitted ONLY on outer-train real sketches; deterministic per SHA and repeat; zero if every per-Role proof flag is constant; no test moments or labels enter placebo construction
B5_input: frozen hidden only; must reproduce parent M1_HIDDEN_READOUT
bootstrap_unit: paired APK resamples stratified by outer fold, label, route and Stage-I predicted side; condition on cohort and fitted models; no retraining or code-family clustering
primary_interval_family: 10 contrasts: B2 versus B1, B3 repeat0 and B4 repeat0 on BA, FN-vs-TN AUC and TP-vs-FP AUC; plus BA versus B0. Ordinary 95% and Bonferroni-adjusted percentile intervals.
secondary_intervals: fixed/broken/net paired differences against B0 and B1, six exploratory ordinary 95% intervals; not primary significance tests
null_interpretation: 20 sensitivity realizations, not independent APKs or an exact conditional-randomization p-value; preserve specified marginals without asserting label exchangeability or causal intervention
source_interpretation: historically inspected development cohort; prospective freeze for this version, not pristine confirmatory evidence or study-wide multiplicity control
prohibited: mixed outer-fold hidden coordinates as training dataset
global OOF route used to select auxiliary training samples
on_pass: permit specification of a separate frozen diagnostic, never automatically change formal CARE-Droid or run future
on_fail: stop this version; report all arms, all repeats and intervals; no tuning
claim_boundary: association of Host-bound static proofs, not consent, runtime causality, malicious data flow or a benign certificate; failure applies to this compact binding descriptor and fixed readout, not every possible Host representation
